premises.text: Business still runs on chaotic reply-all email threads that waste time
premises.evidence_span: Businesses almost all run on these kind of reply all threads

premises.text: A loop is a named email-addressable smart mailing list backed by SaaS search, share, and history
premises.evidence_span: The loop is a smart mailing list easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Loops are created and used through ordinary email with no downloads, accounts, or IT tickets at first
premises.evidence_span: There was no IT help desk request. No one had to download anything

premises.text: Web interface provides searchable threads, attachments, profiles, and suggested related loops
premises.evidence_span: web interface has all the threads, all the content, all the attachments. It has great search

premises.text: Open company loops, digests, and footer/website invites create viral followership across teams and partners
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral

premises.text: Freemium customers pay for customization, admin, and integrations with Google Apps, Dropbox, Salesforce
premises.evidence_span: customers have told us they'll pay for customization

value.text: Make workplace email more productive, collaborative, and social without throwing email away
value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

causal_links.evidence_span: We don't ask for behavior changes, because it's just email
virality is it makes the freemium model really easy

notes: Transcript cuts off mid beta invite (truncated=true). Team/investor bios excluded. Suggested loops and digests folded into web/search and viral followership respectively. Explicit because→virality→freemium noted in D2-D3 link evidence but coded as domain-value only (no premise-premise).
